name: kids-go
description: Kids Igo — children's Go learning game (Cloudflare Free)

scripts.test:engine: npx --yes tsx -e "import { createEmptyBoard, tryPlay, idx } from './packages/go-engine/src/index.ts'; const b=createEmptyBoard(9); const g=b.grid.slice(); g[idx(9,2,2)]='white'; g[idx(9,1,2)]='black'; g[idx(9,3,2)]='black'; g[idx(9,2,1)]='black'; const c=tryPlay({...b,grid:g,toPlay:'black'},2,3); if(!c||c.grid[idx(9,2,2)]!==null) throw new Error('capture fail'); console.log('engine ok');"
